rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing clutter and furniture (planner brief 2026-10-10, Helstrom part 8 R21): each missing piece is drawn by a published vanilla or King of the Murkmire piece of the same object and near size, read from the kit manifests; a piece with no same-object stand-in is taken out (removals[]). Drawn at the missing reference's transform by worldgen/export_interior_bundle.py.

removals.search: Base form ccBGSSSE037-Curios.esl:00000802 (Bungler's Bane) lives in a master the project never sources; the vault Data folder holds only Skyrim.esm and Update.esm (listing, 16k walk 9, 2026-10-01). The only published mushrooms are class fungus, and a stand-in must share the missing piece's class (clutter), so no same-class stand-in exists (R48).
removals.note: A small loose mushroom from the Creation Club lay here; that content is not ours, so the spot stays bare.

removalRule: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (R113): no missing piece ships as a gap. A missing piece takes a same-class stand-in from a published kit where one exists (substitutions[]); a decorative piece whose class no published kit or vault archive holds is taken out of the fit-out (removals[], reason decorative-no-same-class, its search recorded), and the spot is simply empty. A placed piece whose only support was a removed piece is removed with it (reason rests-on-a-removal, restsOn naming that row).
